title: Calendar
wikitext:
'''Calendar and Events''' is an option in the [[SkyBlock Menu]] represented by a clock that shows SkyBlock days and events.

== Usage ==
[[File:Calendar.png|thumb|The first Calendar GUI]]
The first GUI of Calendar and Events lets the [[Player]] see the first 14 current or upcoming [[event]]s, alongside the time to these events, a number of events and the time remaining:
* [[File:Jack o'Lantern.png|21px|link=]] [[Spooky Festival]]
* [[File:Oringo Head.png|21px|link=]] [[Traveling Zoo]]
* [[File:Snowball.png|21px|link=]] [[Season of Jerry]]
* [[File:New Year Cake.png|21px|link=]] [[New Year Celebration]] 
* [[File:SkyBlock Anniversary Event.png|21px|link=]] [[Party Time!|Party Time]]
* [[File:Jukebox.png|21px|link=]] [[Mayor Elections|Mayor Elections Start]]
* [[File:Jukebox.png|21px|link=]] [[Mayor Elections|Mayor Elections Finish]]
* [[File:Fishing Rod.png|21px|link=]] [[Fishing Festival]]
* [[File:Hoppity Head.png|21px|link=]] [[Hoppity's Hunt]] 
* [[File:Pig Head.png|21px|link=]] [[Year of the Pig]]
* [[File:Seal Pet.png|21px|link=]] [[Year of the Seal]]
* [[File:Golden Hoe.png|21px|link=]] [[Harvest Feast]]
The second GUI of Calendar and Events is called {{Green|Calendar}}, it shows every single SkyBlock day of the year, time remaining until the next [[Dark Auction]] and other events.
[[File:Calendar 2.png|thumb|The second Calendar GUI]]

*[[File:Paper.png|21px|link=]] {{Green|No events}}
*{{Green|Current day}} ([[File:Lime Dye.png|24px]]Lime Dye/[[File:Enchanted Lime Dye.png|24px]]Enchanted Lime Dye)
*[[File:Enchanted Nether Brick.png|21px|link=]] [[Dark Auction]]
*[[File:Enchanted Snow Block.png|21px|link=]] [[Jerry's Workshop]] Opens
*[[File:Enchanted Wheat.png|21px|link=]] [[Jacob's Farming Contests]]

Each page of the second GUI is one month (30 SkyBlock days).

Event Rewards can also be found in Calendar and Event. It is represented by a gold block. It acts a stash for unclaimed rewards obtained during events.
